name: toJSON
title: Serialize an R value to JSON text

origin.description: Writes JSON for vectors, lists, matrices, arrays, data frames, factors, and a few other ordinary values.

arguments.name: .na
arguments.text: Text used for a missing value. The default is null.

arguments.name: pretty
arguments.text: Reparse the JSON and indent it with tabs.

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Significant digits for numeric values. The session default is 7.

origin.details: A length-one value at the top level is still an array. Names make an object. Numeric values are padded to digits + 1, then Inf is written as Infinity. pretty reads the text back, so Infinity becomes null.
origin.example: toJSON of 1:10, a named integer, logicals, characters, NULL, numbers with NA and Inf, lists, a data frame, a matrix, a factor, pretty JSON, hex, pi, an environment, an array, and a function. Pieces are separated by ---.

translation.description: Writes JSON for vectors, lists, matrices, arrays, data frames, factors, and a few other ordinary values.
translation.usage: toJSON(x, collapse=None, level=1, with_names=None, na='null', escape_escapes=True, pretty=False, as_is=None, inf=' Infinity', digits=7)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An Atomic, RList, Matrix, Array, DataFrame, Factor, or None.

arguments.name: na
arguments.text: Text used for a missing value. The default is null.

arguments.name: pretty
arguments.text: Reparse the JSON and indent it with tabs.

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Significant digits for numeric values. The default is 7.

translation.details: A length-one value at the top level is still an array. Names make an object. Numeric values are padded to digits + 1, then Inf is written as Infinity. pretty reads the text back, so Infinity becomes null.
translation.example: toJSON of the same values: an integer vector, a named integer, logicals, characters, None, numbers with NA and Inf, lists, a data frame, a matrix, a factor, pretty JSON, hex, pi, an environment, an array, and a function. Pieces are separated by ---.
